title: Machine-learning network analysis infers a conserved five-gene module for cell mechanics
summary: Single-cell mechanical measurements across mouse and human systems were combined with machine-learning-based discriminative network analysis of transcriptomes to infer a conserved module of five genes with putative roles in regulating cell mechanics. The markers were checked in silico across the studied systems, and silencing or overexpressing one target, CAV1, changed the mechanical phenotype accordingly. Preprint; only CAV1 was tested experimentally.
